# Camp Resource: Beer Mystery Machine

Need a beer but are not too concerned about which one, then this is the machine for you!

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Beer Mystery Machine__

**Produces**

Old Possum - 16.66%

Blackwater Brew - 16.66%

Pickaxe Pilsner - 16.66%

Oak Holler Lager - 16.66%

New River Red Ale - 16.66%

Beer - 16.66%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

N/A - Refer to the cooldown period.

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Beer Mystery Machine__ - 500 atoms

Atom Shop - __C.A.M.P. Resource Bundle__ - 1800 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period

**Lockable**

15 caps per use

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
